findings.evidence: Prefer these modern replacements: rg over grep, fd over find, bat over cat, eza over ls, sd over sed, delta or difftastic over diff.
findings.fix: Move this preference table into references only if a user asks for the tool list by name; it is not expert knowledge of the review loop. Record the removal if deleted. Keep the codebase-memory-mcp paragraph, which is project-specific.

findings.evidence: Tool pattern, about 479 lines, with routing and decision tables, but the loop also depends on three mandatory full-file reads (cross-ai-dispatch.md, reviewer-prompts.md, apply-findings.md).
findings.fix: Keep the Tool pattern. Add one routing sentence at each mandatory read that names the section to follow for the current branch, so the body stays the procedure and the references stay the verbatim templates.

findings.evidence: NEVER lists two landmines and defers the rest: The Hard rules for the orchestrator table near the end carries the full list, with reasons.
findings.fix: Keep both lists, but name the two early landmines as the ones that corrupt a review before dispatch, and point to the table by its heading so the early list is not a second incomplete NEVER.

findings.evidence: Description names frameworks and --cross-ai/--no-cross-ai but not the near-miss boundary with code review, writing a plan, or configuring reviewers.
findings.fix: Use when a design, spec, requirements, or plan document needs review-and-fix before the next step. Framework-aware across superpowers, GSD, OpenSpec, Spec Kit, Kiro, BMAD, and generic docs: it orchestrates a clean-context reviewer and routes fixes via the framework skill, slash command, or direct-edit fixer, with optional cross-AI reviewer dispatch via --cross-ai/--no-cross-ai. Respects worktrees, scopes to lifecycle stage, and loops until approved or the iteration cap. Triggered by ai-kit-spec-review, review my spec/plan, naming one of these frameworks alongside a spec/plan/design review, or passing document path(s). Not for reviewing a pull-request diff, writing a new plan, executing a plan, or choosing which cross-AI reviewers to configure.

findings.evidence: MANDATORY — READ ENTIRE FILE, on every run of references/cross-ai-dispatch.md, even for --no-cross-ai, which only needs points 0-2.
findings.fix: Gate the rest: on every run read points 0-2; read points 3-6 only when cross-AI resolution runs; read the pending-lane and Step 1 subprocess sections only on exit 69 or 75. Leave the file where it is.

findings.evidence: Convenience snapshot lists only superpowers and GSD routes, while the description also covers OpenSpec, Spec Kit, Kiro and BMAD, and says any other framework uses the generic fixer.
findings.fix: Keep the profile as the authority. Add one row that the snapshot omits those four frameworks and that a missing row means read the profile, not the fixer.

findings.evidence: parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="review-spec") has no usage description, and no listed test module asserts --help. Output evals and trigger queries are present and realistic.
findings.fix: Add a one-line description and per-subcommand help, and one smoke test that runs the parser with --help and checks the command list. Do not invent a tests/skills path; the repo's tests/test_ai_kit_spec.py is the script-test location.

findings.evidence: 20 queries, 10 should-trigger and 10 should-not, but several negatives share no domain terms with the description (quota, commit message, unit test).
findings.fix: Replace three easy negatives with near-misses: a pull-request diff review, writing a plan from a spec, and configuring cross-AI reviewers. Keep the count.

findings.evidence: Step 0.7 says --no-cross-ai does not skip reading cross-ai-dispatch.md and that the flag skips only points 3-6, while that file's point 2 says --no-cross-ai is requested or TOOLS_PY is missing and then skips points 3-5.
findings.fix: Make both say the same: --no-cross-ai and a missing TOOLS_PY stop after point 2 and skip points 3-6. Quote the point numbers in one place only.

findings.evidence: Named model ids glm-5.2-high, kimi-k3-high and claude-... are stated as Free-plan failures, last_verified 2026-08-28, with no vendor URL dated in the file.
findings.fix: Replace the live model ids with the error text only, or add the cursor-agent --help or vendor docs URL and the date checked. The --mode and --trust claims already cite --help.
